Healthcare analytics

One dataset, three tools: Power BI, Tableau and Excel

Patient, visit, doctor and lab-test data for 10,000 patients, analysed with SQL and rebuilt in each tool to compare how well each one communicates the same KPIs.

Problem

Hospital management needs one view of patient load, diagnoses, lab activity, costs and follow-ups.

Approach

Cleaned the data, wrote KPI queries in MySQL, then built interactive dashboards with slicers in all three tools.

Output

10 KPIs: 10K patients, 1K doctors, $525 average treatment cost, 33.5% abnormal lab results, 49.84% follow-up rate.

What the dashboards show
  • Migraine (2,039), hypertension (2,011) and asthma (2,009) are the most common diagnoses, and the top five are close in volume.
  • About one in three lab results is abnormal, and roughly half of visits require a follow-up.
  • Tableau gave the most visual flexibility, Excel gave the quickest slicer-driven view, and Power BI balanced both for sharing with stakeholders.
Banking analytics

Bank loan and credit-debit dashboards

Two views of banking data: portfolio health for loans (Tableau) and transaction flow across branches and banks (Power BI).

Problem

Track funded amounts, collections, delinquency and default, and understand where money moves.

Approach

Modelled the data, defined KPIs, and built filterable dashboards by branch, state, product, grade and age group.

Output

Loan view: 733M funded, 65.54K loans, 10.19% delinquent rate, 1.50% default rate. Transaction view: credit, debit and branch totals.

What the loan dashboard shows
  • Home loans are the largest product group at 278M, ahead of services (156M) and business (83M).
  • Disbursements peaked at 289M in 2018, then fell sharply in the following years.
  • The 26 to 35 age group has the most loans (23,592), followed by 36 to 45.
SQL

KPI queries in MySQL

The queries behind the healthcare dashboards, written in MySQL Workbench. Each answers one business question.

-- Top 5 diagnosed conditions
SELECT Diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CASES
FROM visit
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY TOTAL_CASES DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- Follow-up rate
SELECT
  ROUND((SUM(IF(`Follow Up Required` = 'Yes',1,0))
    * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS FollowUp_Yes_Rate,
  ROUND((SUM(IF(`Follow Up Required` = 'No',1,0))
    * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS FollowUp_No_Rate
FROM visit;
Flagship project

Aviation passenger grievances: 100,000+ records

A data-driven analysis in Excel and Power BI (with a Tableau build) on government open data, showing where air passengers run into problems and how well those problems get resolved.

Problem

Find complaint patterns, operational bottlenecks and service quality trends across airlines and airports.

Approach

Cleaned, transformed and validated the data, then ran trend, comparative and root-cause analysis across four dashboard pages.

Output

Dashboards on grievance volumes, categories, escalations, resolution performance, feedback and social media complaints.

What the dashboards show
  • DGCA (1,742) and security (1,366) lead the top five categories.
  • By type, ticketing, fares and refunds is the largest group at about 30K, ahead of flight delays (15K) and baggage (9K).
  • Most closed grievances sit in the airline category (174K), and escalations are concentrated in a few names such as Malda (19) and Air India (10).
  • Twitter is the main social media channel (556 grievances versus 4 on Facebook).
Primary research

Public perceptions of data privacy in digital payments

MBA project, Jan to Apr 2025. Survey of 105 respondents on trust in fintech platforms such as Google Pay and Paytm, using the Technology Acceptance Model and Privacy Calculus Theory.

67%prefer digital payments
17%prioritise data privacy
Insight: People like the convenience but rarely weigh privacy, which points to a gap in awareness and communication. Findings were visualised in Excel and Tableau, and the recommendations were cited in fintech trust awareness briefings.
